title: [Peek] Incorrect window/content scaling when re-triggering Peek on a different display
author: daverayment

status.label: Actionable cross-display sizing defect
status.detail: The report has deterministic mixed-DPI steps and visual evidence, but no linked fix owns the cross-display transition itself.

next_action.label: Complete transition-state design
next_action.reason: Separate stale monitor state from the related minimum-size and native-image-size issues before approval.

judgment.rationale: The collaborator report supplies a deterministic mixed-DPI transition and current sizing code exposes monitor-scale state that can become stale across close and reopen.
evidence: The issue reproduces by moving Peek from a 125% display to a 175% display and then re-triggering it from the first display.
Screenshots show both incorrect window dimensions and image/content sizing.
Current Peek code sets ViewModel.ScalingFactor during initialization and separately queries foreground-monitor scale when preview size changes.
judgment.recommended_action: Develop an implementation-grade design for resetting and applying monitor-specific scale during every Peek activation and previewer reuse transition.

issue_context.summary: After Peek is moved between displays with different scaling and opened again from the original display, the window or preview content can retain incorrect dimensions.
known_information: The reporter uses 1920x1080 at 125% and 3840x2160 at 175%.
The issue includes repeatable steps and screenshots of incorrect and correct sizing.
Issues 50243 and 50244 cover related minimum-size and image-native-size problems, but 50243 explicitly describes this cross-display issue as distinct.
inferences: Monitor-specific scale or preview-size state may survive a close/reopen or previewer-reuse boundary.
The related issues may share unit-conversion code without fully covering this activation transition.
issue_context.analysis: The evidence supports design work now; a generic diagnostic request would not change triage. The design must isolate which state is stale and avoid treating the later scoped issues as confirmed duplicates.
initial_investigation: Inspected Peek.UI/PeekXAML/MainWindow.xaml.cs monitor-scale initialization and FilePreviewer_PreviewSizeChanged.
Reviewed live cross-references to issues 50243 and 50244 and confirmed neither is a linked fix for this transition.

information_gaps.information: Which cached object retains the prior monitor's scale or requested preview size
information_gaps.why_needed: This selects the correct lifetime boundary for resetting state without regressing pinned windows or previewer reuse.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Instrument activation, previewer reuse, ScalingFactor, and PreviewSizeChanged values across the documented two-monitor sequence.
